title: 'A relic from a nation that was long gone.'

awacs: AWACS: Single contact, very fast, coming straight for {target}. No escorts. ...It doesn't need any.
AWACS: One bandit inbound. The transponder reads {unit}. {target}, that's the one they warned us about.
allied: PALA Command: Sol 1 has launched. {target} is his. Everyone else, stay out of his sky.
intro: I want to understand the enemy.
Show me how you fly, {target}. Then I will know you.
So you are the one they talk about. Good. I was getting bored.
snap: You were in my sights for a moment. A moment is enough.
parthian: Behind me is not a safe place.
Did you think I could not see you?
evade: A missile is only a question. I know the answer.
overshoot: Overshot. You have a lot to learn.
dark: Radar off. Let us see if you can find me.
winchester: Nothing left to throw. We will finish this another day, {target}.
bingo: My fuel is low. Remember this fight, {target}. I will.
leadDown: So this is how it feels... You fly well, {target}.
defeated: AWACS: Sol 1 is down! {target} brought him down!
AWACS: Bandit splashed. That was Mister X... {target}, you got him.
withdraw: Enough. I understand you now. We will meet again.
